mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TRAN_STATUS = '1' AND TRAN_DATE <= SYSDATE AND TRAN_SENDDATE IS NULL AND TRAN_ETC3 IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_ETC3 = '${group_no}' WHERE TRAN_STATUS = '1' AND TRAN_DATE <= SYSDATE AND TRAN_SENDDATE IS NULL AND TRAN_ETC3 IS NULL AND ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT TRAN_PR as TRAN_PR, 'PH' as ETC3, TRAN_MSG, TRAN_PHONE as TRAN_PHONE, TRAN_CALLBACK as TRAN_CALLBACK, CASE WHEN LENGTHB(TRAN_MSG) <= 90 THEN 'S' ELSE 'L' END as TRAN_TYPE, TO_CHAR(TRAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TRAN_DATE, NVL(TO_CHAR(TRAN_SENDDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), '00000000000000') AS TRAN_SENDDATE, '3' AS p_invoice FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TRAN_ETC3 = '${group_no}' AND TRAN_STATUS = '1'
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_STATUS = '2', TRAN_SENDDATE = SYSDATE WHERE TRAN_ETC3 = '${group_no}'
UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_STATUS = '1', TRAN_ETC3 = NULL, TRAN_SENDDATE = NULL WHERE TRAN_ETC3 = '${group_no}'

UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_STATUS = '${status}', TRAN_RSLT = '${msg_err_code}', TRAN_RSLTDATE = TO_DATE('${sndg_cpee_dt}', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TRAN_END_TELCO = '${telecom}' WHERE TRAN_PR = '${msgid}'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${log_table} SELECT * FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TRAN_PR = '${msgid}'
